verdict.rationale: Riveter delivers scale through batch jobs rather than user-managed concurrent sessions. A single /enrich request can cover up to 10,000 rows, and enrichments fill columns using web scrapes and searches. One request can also fan out across many pages, such as every dental practice and then every dentist. There is a scrape endpoint for individual URLs, and the SDKs handle 429 retries, which implies rate limits exist. missing for 10: documented concurrency limits or parallel scrape session control, throughput/rate-limit figures, independent or hands-on evidence of large-scale concurrent runs.
